_comment: Training recipe, independently designed for this study (no previous-project code, configs or checkpoints used). Fixed at the protocol freeze.
_label_note: location = a recording is positive iff its auscultation location is listed in the encounter's Murmur locations (location-level CirCor annotation; standard in CinC 2022 entries).
_agg_note: Encounter score = max over recordings of the mean segment probability: an encounter is murmur-present if any location carries a murmur.
_epochs_note: Fixed 2026-11-10 by the registered pilot rule (smallest epoch within 0.005 pooled inner-OOF AUROC of each architecture's best, max over architectures): crnn 6, spec_cnn 11, wave_cnn 14 -> 14. Pilot = partition 0, outer fold 0, development data only.
